newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-NatMut says net asset/share A$1.80.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-NatMut says net asset/share A$1.80.

text.p: Life insurance group National Mutal Holdings Ltd said on Tuesday its net asset per share stood at A$1.80 at the end of its first half year at March 31, up from A$1.73 at the end of its full year last September 30.
It said net tangible asset backing was A$1.55, compared with A$1.49 at September 30, 1996.
At the end of March 1996, net asset per share was A$1.61 and net tangible asset backing was A$1.39.

National Mutual, 51 percent owned by French insurance group AXA, earlier announced that its net profit rose to A$175.52 million for the six months to March 31 from 148.31 million in the previous corresponding half.
National Mutual shares closed one cent firmer at A$1.96 on Tuesday.
